name: Tales from the Age of Men
summary: Tales from the Age of Men is a total conversion overhaul mod for Mount & Blade II: Bannerlord, set in the rich and perilous world of Middle-earth during the Third Age, circa year 3000. Immerse yourself in J.R.R. Tolkien's legendary universe as the power of Mordor rises, Gondor braces for war, and the Free Peoples struggle to hold their ground against the tide of darkness. This mod transforms Bannerlord into a fully realized rendition of Middle-earth, featuring iconic factions, custom maps, and unique troop trees for kingdoms like Gondor, Rohan, Mordor, Harad, and more. Engage in epic battles, manage your realm, and shape the fate of the world with authentic weapons, armor, and lore-accurate characters.
